answer: The sonnet index is deterministic from ledger replay, and hence nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the anchor queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier goes on earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1922 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the signal. The deposit is 5 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
